title: Desktop Universal Technology Printer — Generation-1 Universal Acceptance Architecture
correction: G1 is not a reduced common-core demonstrator. It must be able to manufacture/activate a bounded example of every universal function basis class required to reproduce a smaller fully functioning UTP, including RGB/light emission, energy storage, conductance, passive electronics, sensing, actuation, environment handling and at least one active switching/logic route. Performance parity with commercial products and 100% local provenance are not required for G1 acceptance.
external_class: approximately 1 m^3 cabinet class; internal build envelope smaller

two_arm_roles.arm_A: bulk/functional material: structural extrusion, post-mix DIW, conductor, dielectric, electrode, cavity/seal
two_arm_roles.arm_B: precision/process: pick-place, mill/ablate, fine deposition, energy treatment, metrology, fill/evacuate/recover
two_arm_roles.rule: either arm may exchange tools; contamination class and calibration determine allowed swaps

first_machine_required_outputs.example: bounded printed/filled electrochemical or supercapacitor cell
sealed gas-discharge/phosphor RGB cell and/or printed/placed semiconductor emitter
coil/solenoid/motor-stage or printed compliant actuator with inserted precision element
qualified printed thin-film switch if available, otherwise printed interconnect/passives plus inserted seed die as a tracked dependency

specialist_tools_required_in_same_machin: thin-film/fine deposition cartridge or upgrade port
subtractive patterning/milling/ablation; chemical etch only in isolated qualified module
gas/liquid fill, evacuation, seal and gas recovery
acceptance_rule: G1 passes only when it fabricates and commissions P1-PRINTER-MU as a smaller universal printer that can itself execute the same G1 functional basis at its own scale, with all seed dependencies explicitly listed.
seed_dependency_policy: seed parts/materials are permitted and measured; no claim of complete self-replication until critical-dependency fraction reaches the declared threshold and the child can reproduce its own calibration/control chain.
